item: /docs (Swagger) and /redoc are OFF unless OO_API_DOCS=1 (A-021, R411): no page the app serves makes the browser fetch from a third-party host
summary: FastAPI's default /docs and /redoc made the browser load assets from cdn.jsdelivr.net, fastapi.tiangolo.com and (ReDoc) fonts.googleapis.com, and were exempt from the strict CSP. Now docs_url/redoc_url are None and the CSP-exempt prefixes empty unless OO_API_DOCS is exactly 1; /openapi.json stays under the strict CSP. The Help link, the palette entry and the fallback-page link are removed (2 locale keys x12), SECURITY.md, the manual, Quickstart (en, fr) and Architecture state the new truth. Tests: default 404, served-HTML and static-tree grep for the CDN hosts, a Help-documents scan, a child-interpreter test for the switch (read once at import). Not done: vendoring swagger-ui (R285 option B).
